checks.name: Classes recomputed from the C04 audit
checks.evidence: My implementation (exact divisor where known; validated = C04 reliable family, at least 10 gait stances, ankle corr at least 0.98, lever present; interval = lever × exp(±max(0.0488, family max |ln(second/lever)|)) joined with the trial's second estimate ±0.0488; plausible = table masses inside; rescale to the table mass nearest the lever; per-scenario lower/same/worse with a 0.5 % tolerance; lower_confident = lower for every table mass AND on a 401-point continuous grid) gives lower_confident 52, lower_if_recorded_mass 15, own_mass_only 2, no_change 24, mixed 41, the same trial for trial. The family half-widths I derive from the screen block equal the worker's (cutting 0.1567, tire_run 0.1359, meander 0.0952, ..., dynamic_walk 0.0389). The only differences are labels among non-claims: 56 trials with a loaded-sample estimate but no lever estimate are 'not_validated' for the worker and 'no_estimate' for me (316 + 38 = 260 + 94 = 354 either way). Option counts follow: A = 52 + 2 = 54; B = 54 + 15 + 24 = 93; C = 93 + 41 + 316 = 450 = 488 - 38.

checks.name: Post-hoc family widening
checks.evidence: With the C04 band only (no widening) my recomputation gives lower_confident 61, lower_if_recorded_mass 20, mixed 27, and no_change + own_mass_only 26 (5 + 21 by my label split, 1 + 25 by the worker's). This matches the worker's sensitivity line (61/20/27 and 26). Widening only removes 9 confident claims and adds 14 mixed, so it biases against rescaling, not toward it. The answer to José does not depend on it: 354 trials have no validated estimator and at least 27 are mixed under either rule. Option A would be about 62 trials instead of 54 under the narrower band. The sheet details show this, but option A's consequence does not (optional).

checks.name: 'Lower with confidence' under both assumptions
checks.evidence: By construction in my recomputation, every lower_confident trial is lower for every plausible table mass and over the whole continuous interval. The 7 exact trials are lower with zero rescaled error. The 2 AB09 no-match trials (dynamic_walk_1, weighted_walk_1) have no table mass in the interval and are lower_confident through the continuous check only. The handoff discloses this. The 3 tire-run trials are lower even with the 0.136 log family width, because every plausible divisor is far from the own mass (AB03, AB05, AB08).
